spec: docs/SPEC.md4287..4296 CodePoint arithmetic undefined; convert to UInt32
actual: ordinary rejected; direct expected-CodePoint arithmetic compiled exit0 with two S001 warnings instead of required semantic rejection; third case not run
rootCause: InferNumericBinaryExpression validates CodePoint operand domain; InferContextualIntegerBinaryExpression checks equality to expected integer type and returns without domain validation; IsIntegerType includes CodePoint.
decision: Reuse one numeric left-domain validator in both ordinary and contextual arithmetic. Preserve contextual child inference and expected-type mismatch ordering before domain check. Do not weaken existing SLG CodePoint guard.
next: CSharp fix and focused proof first, then compare full SLG contextual/domain arbitration and run new paired cases.
